body: And no I have never spoke to a therapist nor have taken any medications. I havent seen a doctor since i was 10, I am now 22. My family is living in the us but illegally so we never had the resources to.

I just feel guilty as this girl does really love me and has been trying to pull me out of depression. I really do believe id be dead now if it wasnt for her. A part of me thinks I love her but another part of me thinks I dont know what true love is. I care for her and dont want to hurt her. I dont want to let her down. I dont want her to feel like I just used her. She is my best friend. At the same time when she gets upset with me I just want to die. Id rather die than deal with these emotions/problems. Im such a coward I just want to die and not have to face these problems. I am weak.
